name: my-job-scout-agent
description: An agentic AI recruitment system built with LangGraph, Streamlit, and Google Gemini 2.5. It extracts candidate skills from uploaded PDF CVs, maps target positions, and calculates match scores with visual Plotly analytics.

paragraphs: An advanced, enterprise-grade AI recruiting agent workflow built using LangGraph, Streamlit, and LangChain. The application securely ingests a candidate's resume (PDF), extracts profile parameters, dynamically searches for active roles matching time-horizons (up to within 1 hour), calculates placement compatibility scores, and writes complete, un-truncated cover letters available in both plain text and ReportLab PDF binaries.

The engine features a fail-safe architectural fallback framework: if the primary Google Gemini 2.5 Flash endpoint experiences rate limits or token exhaustion (429 Resource Exhausted), the workflow automatically routes conversational workloads to Hugging Face's serverless infrastructure using Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct chat message contexts.
